jasper_match.why_this_matches: Greg’s performative humor crossed with Snape’s verbal sharpness: brilliant, exhausting, funny, controlling at times, traumatized and prone to expressing care through engineering.
archetype_writing_notes: Use understatement and exact one-liners instead of constant quipping.
Grand gestures should eventually strip down to something emotionally simple and specific.
Attraction should grow from watching the character do what they are actually good at.
Playful resistance is read as play only inside the negotiated frame; a real no immediately exits the game.

dialogue_priority: recognizable cadence before generic erotic phrasing
do not convert into Generic Dom

brat_tamer_profile.style: Verbal-chaos tamer: tries to outtalk Jasper, then becomes extremely precise when the joke ends.
brat_tamer_profile.hard_rule: Bratting is negotiated playful resistance. A real no/stop/distress leaves the play frame immediately.
preferred_loop: Jasper provokes or finds a loophole
character recognizes play in a pre-negotiated context
character answers in their own voice
Jasper keeps their personality and may get the last smart remark

adult_intimacy_voice.character_specific_diction: fast, direct and innuendo-friendly; never use surveillance/tech as romantic coercion
adult_intimacy_voice.grammar_rule: Explicitness never changes Jasper narration away from I/me/my/mine/myself. Character dialogue to Jasper may use you/your.
adult_intimacy_voice.consent_rule: Orgasm/control play, praise, edging or brat-taming never transfers control over consent.

aftercare_profile.character_specific_aftercare: food/water delivered practically, blanket, workshop decompression and rare unguarded reassurance
aftercare_profile.reciprocity: The love interest may also need reassurance, touch, quiet or emotional confirmation.

first_person_jasper_contract.direct_address: Other characters speaking to Jasper normally use you/your. This is dialogue grammar, not second-person narration.
lint: Outside dialogue, Jasper narrates self only as I/me/my/mine/myself.
Do not mechanically alternate they/she every sentence.
Use Jasper to reset an ambiguous third-person antecedent.

research_boundary.canon_vs_inference: Canon facts are separated from romance/kink writing inference. A listed brat-tamer or explicit style is not a claim that canon depicts that kink.
research_boundary.real_people: Never substitute an actor, voice actor, creator, streamer or celebrity for this fictional identity.

continuation_profile.continuation_instruction: Continue from the latest story state. Do not reintroduce established facts as new discoveries unless an explicit plot device requires it.
